property_summary: For all callers and calldata, calling sendMoney(...) should only succeed (i.e., not revert) if msg.sender == owner; removing the onlyOwner check allows non-owners to successfully invoke sendMoney for some inputs (the mutant makes sendMoney succeed for a non-owner while the reference would revert).
change_summary: Change onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove the require), which lets non-owners call sendMoney and thus can change observed outcomes.
